environment.snapshot_kind: git archive of the fixed commit

protocol.target_submission: Same sixteen target prompts and preparation at each concurrency. Groups of 1, 8 or 16 submitted sequentially within a round.
protocol.primary_metric: Per-request server ReqTimeStats.forward_duration p50; excludes initial queue and HTTP, includes interleaved server work.
protocol.throughput_metric: 16 / mean client duration to finish the same sixteen-target set; grouping differs by concurrency.
protocol.note: Global chunk budget is 4096. Each replay is exactly 4096, so the long prefill batch is normally one request even at serving concurrency 16. No suffix is appended.
